description: Adapt × Palavreado fusion — the keyword family closes ranks: both rule engines at their high gates first, then both again at medium.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: within the keyword paradigm, does a strict rule engine (Adapt: ordered IntentBuilder require/optional grammar) combined with a bag-of-keywords engine (Palavreado: order-independent, no grammar) at matching tiers cover more utterances than either alone? The two engines implement genuinely different keyword-matching strategies (structured rules vs unordered bag), so this is the keyword league's pooled-upper-bound probe, not a same-engine multi-tier stack.
